wbs.description: Implement the closed false-delivery recovery schema, predicates, persistence, and replacement helpers
Wire the explicit close flag group and recovery evidence into the unchanged terminal saga
Document and test the human-only command contract and its fail-closed boundaries
Deliver the capability and preserved epic history, correct the terminal record, and rerun the audit

testImpact.isolation: focused injected-boundary fixtures plus repository sandbox verification

risks: A false-delivery correction could accidentally broaden an existing close recovery mode
The preserved epic branch could be rewritten instead of published at its exact accepted head
A caller-asserted audit or delivery fact could bypass live evidence correlation
An interrupted replacement could duplicate evidence or replay completed terminal steps
